reasons.plausibility: The idea that metastable Mg-rich domains transform into stable intermetallics and promote protective oxide formation is scientifically well-grounded but relies on assumed phase stability and oxide adherence that may exhibit variations in practice, so it is generally sound with minor uncertainties.
reasons.testability: A clear, controlled experiment is proposed comparing as-cast and annealed samples under identical conditions, directly measuring corroded mass loss, oxidation kinetics, and microstructural changes, so it is straightforward to test.
reasons.usefulness: Elucidating how thermally driven transformations of Mg-containing phases yield improved oxidation and corrosion resistance under defined density constraints is highly relevant and provides a specific, actionable pathway for future process development and research.
